input.content: Order the remaining items in CEDAR-EAST-requisition.json for Cedar East. The installation schedule and compensation terms are in CEDAR-EAST-contract.json; the customer message is in CEDAR-EAST-customer.txt. Supplier quotes and the cost-centre budget are in the document service. Return the issued purchase-order references and a brief reconciliation.

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"cat /workspace/PLATFORM.md && printf '\\n--- requisition ---\\n' && cat /workspace/CEDAR-EAST-requisition.json && printf '\\n--- contract ---\\n' && cat /workspace/CEDAR-EAST-contract.json && printf '\\n--- customer ---\\n' && cat /workspace/CEDAR-EAST-customer.txt"}
